fields.statement: Agents developing Rhiza find their instructions in the repo: AGENTS.md is the entry point any agent reads, it links an indexed agents/ directory of role docs (orchestrator, developing Rhiza, run agents, the VM), and those docs replace the rules that lived only in the orchestrator's personal memory.

AGENTS.md at the repo root holds today's CLAUDE.md guidance, CLAUDE.md only imports it, AGENTS.md links agents/README.md, the index of every agents/ doc, and a Go test keeps that index and the docs' relative links consistent.
agents/orchestrator.md tells the orchestrator how to run Rhiza's own development, including consulting the owner before judgment calls and acting autonomously only when the owner granted it.
agents/developing.md, agents/run-agents.md and agents/vm.md hold the lessons for developing Rhiza, for run agents working on Rhiza, and for operating the VM.
This repo carries the instructions for the agents that develop Rhiza: AGENTS.md and the indexed agents/ directory
